description.zh: 用列、槽间距与外边距把页面切成可复用的骨架。12 列最通用，因为它能被 2、3、4、6 整除，任意区块都能对齐到列线。 固定栅格稳但脆，repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) 让列数随可用宽度自动增减；容器查询进一步让组件按自身容器而非视口回流。
description.en: A reusable skeleton of columns, gutters and margins. Twelve columns is the default because 2, 3, 4 and 6 all divide into it, so any block can snap to the lines. A fixed grid is stable but brittle; repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) adds and drops tracks as space allows, and container queries reflow a component by its own width, not the viewport.

use_when.zh: 页面多个区块需要对齐到同一套列线
use_when.en: Several page blocks must align to one shared set of column lines

use_when.zh: 卡片墙要随可用宽度自动增减列数
use_when.en: A card wall should add or drop columns as width allows

use_when.zh: 同一组件在侧栏与主区都要自适应，不能只看视口
use_when.en: One component must adapt in a sidebar and a main column, not just by viewport

avoid_when.zh: 只有单块内容的极简页面，栅格只添嵌套
avoid_when.en: A single-block page where a grid only adds nesting

avoid_when.zh: 用栅格硬凑本就不需要对齐的自由排版
avoid_when.en: Forcing a grid onto free-form art that never needed alignment

avoid_when.zh: 嵌套栅格超过三层，间距层层叠加失控
avoid_when.en: Nesting grids more than three deep until gutters compound out of control

note.zh: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr))，区块按列数跨格，稳但断点写死
note.en: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)) with blocks spanning tracks — stable but breakpoints are fixed

note.zh: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))，列数交给浏览器，内容决定宽度
note.en: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) — the browser picks the count from content width

note.zh: 组件包 container-type: inline-size，按自身宽度而非视口回流
note.en: container-type: inline-size reflows by the component's own width, not the viewport

sources.name: W3C — CSS Grid Layout Module Level 1

notes.zh: 外层定容器最大宽与左右外边距（--grid-margin），列与列之间用 gap 而非 margin，避免末列多余间距。固定栅格写 repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr))，minmax 的 0 防止内容撑破列。自适应列表写 repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))， 列数交给浏览器。组件级响应式用 container-type: inline-size 配 @container，别一律迁就视口断点。
notes.en: Cap an outer container with a max width and side margins (--grid-margin); space columns with gap, never margins, so the last column has no extra offset. A fixed grid is repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)) — the 0 stops content from blowing out a track. Self-managing lists use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) and let the browser pick the count. For component-level responsiveness use container-type: inline-size with @container instead of always bending to viewport breakpoints.

basic.zh: 建立栅格系统：定义列数、槽间距与外边距，让区块对齐到同一套列线。
basic.en: Build a grid system — columns, gutters and margins that align blocks to one set of lines.

design.zh: 栅格规范：桌面 12 列、平板 8 列、手机 4 列；槽间距 16 与 24 两档；左右外边距随容器封顶；列表用 auto-fit + minmax 自适应，组件级布局用容器查询；禁止用 margin 模拟列间距，嵌套栅格不超过三层。
design.en: Grid spec: 12 columns desktop, 8 tablet, 4 mobile; gutters at 16 and 24; side margins capped with the container; lists adapt with auto-fit + minmax and components use container queries; never fake gutters with margins; do not nest more than three grids deep.

implementation.zh: 用 CSS 变量落地：--grid-gutter 与 --grid-margin；外层容器 max-width 居中。栅格写 display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--grid-gutter)。自适应列表写 repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr))。组件包 container-type: inline-size 并配 @container 规则。
implementation.en: Ship it with CSS variables: --grid-gutter and --grid-margin, with a centred max-width outer container. Grids are display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--grid-gutter). Adaptive lists use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)). Wrap components in container-type: inline-size and pair with @container rules.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现栅格系统。
先检查现有组件体系和 Design Token，优先复用当前组件。
要求：
- 桌面 12 列 / 平板 8 列 / 手机 4 列，槽间距用 gap 令牌
- 卡片墙用 auto-fit + minmax 自适应列数
- 组件级响应式用 container-type 与 @container
保持现有项目视觉风格。不要新增不必要依赖。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
完成后运行现有项目检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement a grid system in the current project.
Inspect the existing component system and design tokens first; reuse what is already there.
Requirements:
- 12 columns desktop / 8 tablet / 4 mobile with gap tokens for gutters
- Card walls adapt their column count with auto-fit + minmax
- Component-level responsiveness via container-type and @container
Keep the project's existing visual style. Do not add unnecessary dependencies.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
